facts.program: Energize CT residential energy optimization heat pump incentive
facts.claim: $1,500 per ton for air source and air-to-water heat pumps that replace fossil fuel (oil, propane, natural gas) or electric resistance heating, for installations on or after September 1, 2026 (the rate was $1,000 per ton earlier in 2026), up to a combined $10,000 limit. The system must be on the program's Qualified Product List and installed by a contractor in the Energize CT Heat Pump Installer Network.
facts.eligibility: Replacing oil, propane, natural gas or electric resistance heat; Qualified Product List unit; Energize CT Heat Pump Installer Network contractor. Program documents describe the program for Eversource and United Illuminating electric customers (not confirmed on the page).
facts.dates: Installations January 1 to December 31, 2026; $1,500 per ton from September 1, 2026.
facts.notes: Page text could not be read by Claude (energizect.com shows a bot check); figures come from a summary of the page supplied by the site owner on 2026-10-10 and should be re-read in a normal browser at the monthly check. Other sources conflict on the per-ton figure ($1,000 earlier in the year; an income-based $1,500 tier effective April 1, 2026 was quoted in a search excerpt), so the page tells readers to confirm the rate.

facts.program: Energize CT residential air source heat pump incentive
facts.claim: $250 per ton up to $2,500 per customer account for air source heat pumps used for cooling only, added to unconditioned spaces, or replacing existing heat pumps without integrated controls. It excludes fossil fuel or electric resistance replacements. Tonnage uses the AHRI cooling capacity (1 ton is 12,000 BTU/h); network installer and Qualified Product List unit required; random post-inspections.
facts.eligibility: Not a replacement of fossil fuel or electric resistance heat.
facts.notes: Page text could not be read by Claude (energizect.com shows a bot check); figures come from a summary of the page supplied by the site owner on 2026-10-10 and should be re-read in a normal browser at the monthly check.
